description: The chart illustrates the performance gain of three models, GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL, under two supervision conditions, strong and weak. The horizontal axis lists the model names in the order of GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL, while the vertical axis is labeled "Performance Gain (+%)" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, marked at intervals of 5. For each model, two bars are presented side by side, with the left bar representing "Strong Supervision" in blue with diagonal white stripes and the right bar representing "Weak Supervision" in solid blue; the "Strong Supervision" bars have approximate values of 24, 9, and 15 for GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL, respectively, while the corresponding "Weak Supervision" bars have values of around 5, 3, and 5. The bars are grouped by model, with no specific sorting order beyond the listed model names, and no visual emphasis is applied to any particular bar.
